name: spreadsheets
description: Create, edit, analyze, visualize, render, and export spreadsheets, Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets-ready workbooks for agent workflows.

interface.longDescription: Create, edit, inspect, render, verify, and export XLSX, CSV, and TSV spreadsheets locally, including local XLSX authoring for native Google Sheets handoff. Use Spreadsheets when the durable output or target is a spreadsheet, workbook, sheet, Google Sheet, or CSV file. Use Excel Live Control for a workbook already open in Microsoft Excel desktop through the local OfficeKit Add-in.
